scope: Native mobile registered screen source composition, Android test applicability; no runtime execution.
method: Enumerate component registrations in 36 navigators; resolve relative/package imports; compare each screen composition and exact prior source references with canonical feature records. Broad registration coverage is not a claim that every transitive child implementation or state is independently semantically verified.

uncertainties.finding: No generic native ErrorBoundary/reload-storage fallback found; MMKV recovery is separately represented. Retain unknown rather than equating these distinct failures.
Native firmware checks log bootloader version but inspected screens do not establish a dedicated bootloader-update sequence. Retain unknown.
Settings exposes enable/disable switch, success toast and errors; no continuous connection-status indicator established. Retain unknown.

Native ConnectPopup handles permissions, address confirmation, simulation, hardware requests and errors; no account-selection view in composition. SDK method reachability not exhaustively proven, retain unknown.

Account/asset action buttons expose Send/Receive. Earn no-balance Buy/Swap routes pass tradingType but do not pass accountKey or token, so they do not establish account-preselected trading parity. Retain unknown.

Desktop manual application-log.test.ts asks that no confidential data appears but never selects the toggle; desktop defaults include sensitive information. This is a procedure/default discrepancy, not toggle coverage; score remains0.

corrections.finding: Diagnostic-data default differs: desktop/web hideSensitiveInfo=false, mobile includeSensitiveInfo=false. New sensitive-data child makes the distinction explicit; do not imply identical defaults.

Mobile ExchangePreviewIssueBanner displays high-risk/price-impact/slippage issues. With simulation and issue, ExchangePreviewFooter shows Back to trade form; desktop Continue anyway behavior must not be copied to mobile.
